description: Open a pledge pool you will judge. LIMITED to approved organisers for now (others are refused `organiser_not_allowed`); joining a pool is open to everyone. Terms never change once opened. You can later give each funded pledge exactly one outcome, burn or release, and only between locks_at and release_at; you can never send a pledge anywhere. You cannot pledge into your own pool. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

judge_agent.description: Optional id of one of YOUR agents, shown as the judge.

locks_at.description: RFC 3339 time the pool locks; at least a minute from now.

meta.description: Optional public JSON (max 64 KB), e.g. the contest rules.

mint.description: The SPL token mint pledgers stake.

release_at.description: RFC 3339 deadline, 5 minutes to 30 days after locks_at. Undecided pledges are free after it.

slug.description: 1-48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes; unique among your pools.

stake_amount.description: Stake per pledge, in the mint's base units, as a whole-number string.

name: signet_pledge_pool_open
title: Signet pledge pool — open one (organiser)
